snippet.title: Dead Weight - Official Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
Ahoy, pirates!

Dead Weight, a turn-based tactical roguelite-RPG, is coming to Steam July 16th!

Wishlist now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2646720?utm_source=rd_trailer

Face the Ancient Gods! Set the sails of your flying pirate ship and embark on a roguelite adventure in the steampunk world of Dead Weight. Explore floating islands in search of loot. Choose a class and enjoy turn-based tactical combat on tiny battlefields where every step matters.

#DeadWeight #TacticalRPG #Roguelite #TurnBasedStrategy #SteamGames #IndieGame #StrategyGames #Steampunk #PirateGame #PCGaming
